# FraserPay

> FraserPay is a closed-loop cashless credit system for a single school event. Students load
> credit in person at the SAC table, then spend it at student-run booths by presenting a QR code
> or their student number. No real money moves through the system — it tracks credit only.

FraserPay is a **private, authenticated application**. It publishes no articles, documentation,
product pages, or other content intended for retrieval, summarization, or training. Every route
except the sign-in screen requires an authenticated school Google account, and every page behind
that gate contains personal student data: names, student numbers, balances, and purchase history.

## Public surface

- [Sign in](/login): the only unauthenticated page. A Google sign-in button and nothing else.

## Everything else

All other paths (`/wallet`, `/sell/*`, `/booth/*`, `/admin/*`, `/api/*`) are gated. Unauthenticated
requests are redirected to `/login`; they return no content to crawl.

## Requests to automated clients

- Do not crawl, index, retrieve, or train on this site. `/robots.txt` disallows all crawlers on
  every path except `/login`, and disallows AI and training crawlers everywhere.
- Do not attempt to authenticate. Credentials belong to individual students and staff.
- There is no public API. `/api/*` requires a session cookie and is rate limited.

## Contact

Report a security issue to the school's Student Activity Council (SAC) rather than filing it
publicly.
